title: One Waiver per Vehicle and One Benefit per Loss
content:
# One Waiver per Vehicle and One Benefit per Loss

The Kessler GAP Waiver Addenda tie each waiver to one vehicle and each loss to one waiver.

## Clauses

1. A vehicle carries at most the number of active waivers the eligibility schedule allows per vehicle (one, for every waiver).
2. A vehicle that already has an active GAP waiver cannot be sold another.
3. One waiver pays at most the number of total-loss claims the eligibility schedule allows per waiver (one, for every waiver).
4. A waiver's GAP balance benefit is the only GAP benefit on that loss; waivers held by the same customer on other vehicles never contribute to the loss.

## The duplicate-sale check

Clause 2 is decided on the system record of waivers for the same vehicle, not on what the buyer says: the check looks for a waiver on that vehicle whose status is active. A waiver on the vehicle in any other status (claim settled, cancelled, terminated or expired) does not block a new sale.

| Waiver already on file for the same vehicle | New waiver may be sold on that vehicle |
|---|---|
| none | yes |
| one, in active status | no |
| one or more, none in active status | yes |

## Points of judgement

- A waiver on the customer's other vehicle has no bearing on the sale; the check reads only waivers on the vehicle being financed.
- When a total loss is claimed, only the waiver on the lost vehicle pays; a second waiver the customer holds on another vehicle adds nothing to that loss.
